title: Ant Digital Technologies Brings 'Agent Super Factory' to Hong Kong FinTech Week, Unveils New KYA Solution
excerpt: How does an agent factory operate? From enterprises raising business needs, to large models providing intelligent capabilities, to different agents being develo
content_html:
How does an agent factory operate? From enterprises raising business needs, to large models providing intelligent capabilities, to different agents being developed, deployed, and securely collaborating to complete tasks. This is not only a technical path for agents to enter enterprises at scale, but is also becoming a new topic in enterprise AI development.

Hong Kong FinTech Week 2026 x StartmeupHK Festival opened on November 2. Ant Digital Technologies appeared at the event with its "AI Agent Super Factory" solution and announced an upgrade to its security brand ZOLOZ, launching KYA (Know Your Agent), a trusted identity governance solution for the agent era. John Lee, Chief Executive of the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region, visited the Ant Digital Technologies booth to learn about the relevant technological capabilities and application practices.
